import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Find features with strong association (p < 0.01)
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[feats.y==1], x[feats.y==0])
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # Select top features by p-value
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(p_values)
    top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:20]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation > 0.6
    keep_features = []
    seen = set()
    
    # Build correlation matrix for top features
    X_top = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X_top.T)
    
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(top_features):
        if fid1 in seen:
            continue
        keep_features.append(fid1)
        seen.add(fid1)
        
        # Check correlations with remaining features
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(top_features[i+1:], i+1):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                seen.add(fid2)
    
    # Try pairwise interactions
    best_score = -np.inf
    best_interaction = None
    
    # Test interaction terms for top features
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(keep_features):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(keep_features[i+1:], i+1):
            col1 = feats.column(fid1)
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            interaction = feats.x[:, col1] * feats.x[:, col2]
            
            # Simple test: check if interaction improves prediction
            X_test = np.column_stack([feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2], interaction])
            scores, _ = f_classif(X_test, feats.y)
            if scores[-1] > best_score:
                best_score = scores[-1]
                best_interaction = (fid1, fid2)
    
    # If we found a significant interaction, use it
    if best_interaction and best_score > 1.0:  # threshold for significance
        return Design(
            drivers=(best_interaction[0],),
            columns=(best_interaction[0], best_interaction[1]),
            products=(best_interaction,),
            loadings={best_interaction[0]: 1.0}
        )
    
    # Otherwise, return top single feature
    if keep_features:
        return Design(
            drivers=(keep_features[0],),
            columns=(keep_features[0],),
            products=(),
            loadings={keep_features[0]: 1.0}
        )
    
    # No mechanism found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
